evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Displaying thumbnail photos requires a complementary capability to supply/manage photos (upload, link, or avatar management). The backlog contains no story for uploading/associating user photos or choosing an avatar, nor any mechanism tying photos to join/account, so the thumbnail feature cannot be implemented without that missing story.
Standards compliance is a developer non-functional goal; no complementary capability missing within backlog to achieve it.
Definitions list is standalone and does not require additional missing stories to be useful to the team.
Creating database indexes is an implementation task to support performance story (PP-048); complementary technical work is assumed and backlog contains performance story.
Cross-browser compatibility is a developer goal; no missing complementary capability required in backlog to define it further.
Accessibility compliance is a non-functional developer goal; no additional user-level capabilities are required to state this goal here.
Performance expectation is covered and supported by developer stories (PP-045); no missing complementary capability evident in backlog.
Unicode support is a standalone requirement; related stories reference user-visible behavior but no missing complementary capability is required here.
Sensible URLs is a design requirement; no complementary capability missing to achieve this stated requirement.
Nice error pages are a UI goal; no additional missing user story is required to support this requirement in context.

evaluations.evidence: As a Researcher, I want results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Non-identifiable storage requires complementary stories for anonymization/export options, consent handling, or opt-out and mechanisms to strip identifiers from stored transcripts/metrics. The backlog contains stories that expose identifiable data (show who gave what PP-036, thumbnails PP-042, export/view transcripts PP-017/018/019) but lacks stories to implement anonymization or researcher-specific non-identifiable exports, so the feature cannot be implemented completely.
Metrics on use are supported by storage, browsing, and transcript/export stories; while implementation details are needed, no required complementary capability is absent from backlog.
